scripts.dev: pnpm run build:workspace-packages && pnpm run clean:frontend-caches && concurrently --raw --names shell-api,rdf-api,gis-api,shell,rdf,gis "pnpm run dev:shell-api" "pnpm run dev:rdf-api" "pnpm run dev:gis-api" "pnpm run dev:shell" "pnpm run dev:rdf" "pnpm run dev:gis"
scripts.clean:frontend-caches: pnpm --dir products/shell/frontend exec ng cache clean && pnpm --dir products/rdf-explorer/frontend exec ng cache clean && pnpm --dir products/gis-explorer/frontend exec ng cache clean
scripts.dev:rdf-standalone: concurrently --raw --names api,web "pnpm run dev:rdf-api" "pnpm run dev:rdf"
scripts.dev:gis-standalone: concurrently --raw --names api,web "pnpm run dev:gis-api" "pnpm run dev:gis"
